import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import
from src.service import import_contacts


def fresh(isolation=""):
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", isolation_level=isolation)
    initialize(c)
    handle_add(c, {"email": "a@b.com", "name": "Alice"})
    return c


def raises(fn):
    try:
        fn()
    except ValueError:
        return True
    return False


for iso in ("", None, "DEFERRED"):
    c = fresh(iso)
    r = handle_import(c, {"contacts": [
        {"email": "  A@B.COM ", "name": " Alice "},
        {"email": "x@Y.org", "name": " Xavier "},
    ]})
    assert r == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1}, r
    assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b.com", "Alice"), ("x@y.org", "Xavier")]
    assert not c.in_transaction
    assert import_contacts(c, []) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
    assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": []}) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}

    before = list_contacts(c)
    bad_batches = [
        [{"email": "n@n", "name": "N"}, "notobj"],
        [{"email": "n@n", "name": "N"}, {"email": "m@m"}],
        [{"email": "n@n", "name": "N"}, {"email": "m@m", "name": "M", "x": 1}],
        [{"email": "n@n", "name": "N"}, {"email": "N@N ", "name": "N2"}],
        [{"email": "a@b@c", "name": "N"}],
        [{"email": "@b", "name": "N"}],
        [{"email": "a@", "name": "N"}],
        [{"email": "a b@c", "name": "N"}],
        [{"email": "ab@c", "name": "   "}],
        [{"email": 1, "name": "N"}],
        [{"email": "a@c", "name": None}],
    ]
    for b in bad_batches:
        assert raises(lambda: import_contacts(c, b)), b
        assert list_contacts(c) == before
    for env in [None, [], {}, {"contacts": None}, {"contacts": {}}, {"contacts": [], "x": 1}]:
        assert raises(lambda: handle_import(c, env)), env

    # Database failure mid-batch rolls back earlier writes.
    c.execute("CREATE TRIGGER boom BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'z@z' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
    try:
        import_contacts(c, [{"email": "q@q", "name": "Q"}, {"email": "a@b.com", "name": "Changed"}, {"email": "z@z", "name": "Z"}])
        raise AssertionError("expected failure")
    except sqlite3.DatabaseError:
        pass
    assert list_contacts(c) == before
    assert not c.in_transaction
print("ok")
